messages:
maria (sec): FYI — compliance asked us to tighten retention on developer SIEM exports. proposal: restrict dev exported logs to 30d, keep prod at 365d. will require RBAC change + KMS unwrap gating for forensic snapshots. :lock:

tony (infra): 30d for dev ok from cost/privacy side. we need a clear rollback plan if dev teams complain. who approves RBAC changes?

maria (sec): approvers = angela (compliance) + security lead. we should also add a JIT unmasking flow for oncall/forensics (timeboxed, audited). draft runbook below.

vikram (plat): JIT sounds good. prefer to gate KMS unwrap with a short-lived token instead of handing wide kms:Decrypt perms. can we use existing kms-proxy service?

angela (compliance): +1 to JIT. make sure the approval includes justification and ticket id. retention change needs a short notice to developers and a privacy review doc.

sam (oncall): For incident response, we need temp access that preserves chain-of-custody. Suggest: 2FA + manager approval + 1hr default unwrap TTL, extendable to 8hr with supervisor justification. Also add automatic export scrub for PII fields during dev exports.

maria (sec): agreed. proposed groups:
- security:analysts (read-only masked)
- security:forensics (can request unwrap via JIT)
- infra:export-admins (manage export configs)
Will update iam policies and open PR.

tony (infra): can you paste the iam snippet you want? easier to review with terraform diff.

maria (sec): sure, draft snippet below:

```hcl
resource "aws_iam_policy" "security_analysts_masked" {
  name = "security-analysts-masked"
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17",
    Statement = [
      { Effect = "Allow", Action = ["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], Resource = "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:alias/redwood-logs" },
      { Effect = "Deny", Action = ["kms:Decrypt"], Resource = "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/*" }
    ]
  })
}
```

vikram (plat): looks fine. for forensics we should not give direct kms:Decrypt either — use kms-proxy to unwrap and log the request + requester metadata. store audit log to_secure_bucket with retention 1yr.

angela (compliance): record retention for audit logs = 1 year minimum. also need alert correlation metadata so vuln triage can link SIEM alerts to tickets (JIRA or linear).

sam (oncall): adding vuln triage: can we include alert->ticket id in the unwrap request so we have provenance?

maria (sec): yes. unwrap request form should require ticket id and short justification. ci-bot will create an audit entry and attach to ticket.

ci-bot: Created issue: https://redwood.internal/issues/SEC-4321 — "Implement JIT-KMS unwrap + RBAC changes for SIEM exports" (assignee: maria). CI job: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/SEC-4321

tony (infra): timeline?

maria (sec): aim to land infra PR + runbook by EOD Friday. rollout plan:
1) update RBAC groups (staged)
2) enable masking in dev exports + notify teams
3) enable JIT-KMS proxy for forensics (canary)
4) adjust retention enforcement via exporter config

angela (compliance): send template notice to devs, include rollback instructions and contact for exceptions.

maria (sec): sending notice draft in #general later today. sam — can you validate runbook steps for oncall?

sam (oncall): will review tonight. also add playbook snippet for emergency unmask (SOC escalation) with 15min approval SLA.

maria (sec): noted. final TODOs:
- PR for IAM changes (maria)
- KMS proxy config changes (vikram)
- Runbook update + notice (maria + angela)
- CI job to enforce retention (tony)

angela (compliance): once done, compliance will sign off and we'll schedule a 1-week feedback window. :white_check_mark:

maria (sec): thanks all. tagging this as actioned in SEC-4321. leaving thread open for minor questions.
